purpose: Expand the DOS Pack-Ice resource dialect: backward sentinel bits, literal runs, and overlapping backward LZ matches. This is a coherent leaf of resource loading, with no persistent decoder state or device operations.

native.status_reason: Accepted status remains migrated pending supervisor review. Proposed verified-under-assumptions for the exact CBMC domains below; full-window malformed semantics, native safety extensions and bridge integration do not acquire an unrestricted proof.

inputs: source byte buffer, available size, header at byte zero
output in/out byte buffer, available size
non-null IceResult pointer; accessible initialized storage for supplied lengths
outputs: IceStatus: OK, BAD_MAGIC, TRUNCATED, RANGE, LIMIT
partial output bytes, next backward cursors, write count and outer token count
effects: reads header low size words and backward source bytes
reads output seed/already written bytes for matches
writes only output indices below supplied output_size
no allocation, global mutable state, I/O, interrupts or callbacks
preconditions: source and output buffers do not alias
header begins at zero on the recognized decoding path
for exact full-ring L1 comparison provide both complete 65536-byte initialized windows
for smaller ordinary file buffers every L1 access must be within available storage; RANGE/TRUNCATED are native safety extensions, not DOS errors
bridge source-read and output-write physical footprints must not alias; no live stack, mutable code/table, device/VGA or concurrent mutation alias
IceResult storage is independent of source/output storage.

The bridge conservatively requires declared low-word source/output physical extents to be disjoint, treating a zero size as a 65536-byte extent; this is additional to the actual-footprint alias restriction.
interface.projection: Copy source window and output seed from ordinary RAM into byte buffers. Native step then copying output back equals the compared L1 RAM step on the stated boundary in tested cases. SI/DI diagnostics are retained by the bridge. No register or segment object enters L2.
interface.bad_magic: L0/L1 consume one or two little-endian words, advancing SI by 2 or 4 modulo 65536, preserve DI and clear DF. Bridge handles arbitrary incoming SI, including a contiguous word operand spanning FFFF. Native header-at-zero returns BAD_MAGIC with cursor 2/4 and no writes.
interface.malformed: L0 performs no validation and may loop forever or read/write the entire fixed windows. L1 adds a 2000000-outer-iteration guard. Native retains full-ring behavior and guard with full buffers; smaller buffers stop before unavailable access with partial writes retained. Native missing-byte errors cannot be compared to a DOS truncated file: DOS has surrounding memory, not a file-length parameter.
interface.status_mapping: Native OK/BAD_MAGIC map to UGH_OK, LIMIT to UGH_BUDGET; RANGE/TRUNCATED are safety extensions with no L1 short-allocation analogue. A recognized nonzero header position is unsupported by this bridge contract.

callers.observations: ES becomes DS for map copy; DF must be zero for MOVSW; returned SI/DI overwritten; saved working registers remain preserved. No arithmetic flag tested before overwrite.
ES becomes DS for map copy; SI loaded from renderer scratch, DI/CX/DX replaced; DF drives MOVSW. Preserved registers kept by bridge; no arithmetic result flag consumed.
ES read at 4C94 then used as DS at 4C9B; SI overwritten with FA00, DI overwritten by LES at 4C96; DF drives REP MOVSW at 4CA0. No arithmetic flag branch.
sets ES to scratch and DI=0; forwards all decoder effects. Existing L1 wrapper is linked unchanged.

indirect.classification: No indirect transfer inside the component. Direct entry and wrapper fallthrough; L1 diagnostic dispatch resolves the same exported adapter. No stored code-pointer reference to 4CAD found in model facts.

read: DS:SI header; low BE16 fields at header+6/header+10; size high halves ignored
DS backward bytes with 16-bit SI wrap
ES match references, including seed bytes and overlap
SS stack saved registers and near return frames in L0
write: ES backward output bytes with 16-bit DI wrap
L0 stack scratch from saves and helper CALLs; excluded only below incoming return frame by existing harness
owners: ZERO:IceDecodeWorkspace: declared 64768 bytes; real outputs 32000 or 64768
picture palette copy belongs to caller, not ice_decode
memory.layout: Literal header magic ICE!, packed endpoint including header, unpacked size. Low words replace cursors absolutely, so initial DI and a recognized nonzero header position are not portable buffer offsets.
memory.aliases: Backward match overlap is required and preserved. Source/output alias, output/code tables, output/live stack, and device-aperture alias are outside the bridge contract. Full copied windows may overlap physically only if the actually accessed footprints do not.

assumptions: Immutable original ICE code tables equal rebuilt GAME tables; checked against actual L1 table reads in primitive harness.
No asynchronous writer changes either buffer or the tables during decoding.
A valid native result pointer and accessible storage; no source/output C alias.
Compiler and ctypes ABI are trusted; build/native receipts record compiler and input hashes.
Handwritten ice_smt.py queries prove only their models; installed z3 5.4.1 replaces the old scratch DLL. They do not raise C evidence levels.

CBMC whole domain: disjoint nondeterministic source/output buffers (16,6) or (32,4) bytes, header position zero, packed low word <= source storage and output low word <= output storage. Only L1 accesses assume in-range storage; native has no corresponding assume. Arbitrary magic, ignored high words, malformed bitstreams and output seed are included under those bounds.

CBMC step domain: source storage 16, output storage 8; arbitrary sentinel byte, equal initial cursors within their buffer or FFFF, equal immutable input and arbitrary output seed, no native error. Every L1 access of every composed step must remain in those buffers. Zero source/output alias and immutable L0 tables.

Whole proofs keep both production guards at 2000000. The checked progress bound is floor(output_storage/2)+1 outer iterations (4 for output 6, 3 for output 4). Each iteration can contain a literal run and a match; the token counters count outer iterations, not individual LZ symbols.

Step wrappers mechanically extract the actual C bodies and tag only their terminal branch. Prefix wrappers establish the initial relation. CBMC checks reader/environment preservation, an arbitrary observer output byte, and continuing-step progress. Induction applies only to executions satisfying the per-step storage assumption; it does not prove general full-window well-formedness.

Literal-parser CBMC query depends on the DEC/JNS count lemma, established by exhaustive enumeration of actual compiled L1 copy-count code for all literal encodings. The C parsers are checked, not replaced by handwritten SMT.
Old guard-limited executable family (guard changed to 1 in generated copies) is A for that finite prefix family only; it is separate from the new unchanged-production-code B proofs.

amiga.finding: No Amiga correspondence needed to derive this DOS codec boundary. This pilot makes no claim that JOKE resources or Amiga decoder behavior equal DOS.

uncertainty: General 64 KiB windows and real resource sizes still have C evidence, not whole-code A/B equivalence. Largest completed direct whole profiles were source16/output6 and source32/output4 bytes; source32/output8 timed out after 180 seconds. Source32/output6 and step source16/output16 also did not finish; initial timeout-cleanup bug extended their measured wall time and was fixed with Windows job ownership.
No malformed full-ring termination proof. Only bounded ordinary-buffer executions have checked progress; the original L1 guard is retained for other states.
No source/output, code-table, live-stack or device alias semantics in the native bridge contract; bridge integration remains differential evidence.
TRUNCATED/RANGE are native safety extensions and are excluded from L1-equivalence states by available-storage assumptions; their ordinary regression tests remain C.
Handwritten SMT models remain A only for models; no code-level promotion follows from them.

CBMC literal query uses the separately proven compiled-code copy-count lemma. Per-step induction is conditional on every composed L1 access remaining inside the bounded storage, not a parser validity proof.
Dedicated whole-worker D matrix remains pending. Accepted status stays migrated until supervisor reviews the proposed verified-under-assumptions status and its narrow domains.
